$comment: Pipeline memory. The cheap change-detection gate compares the current fingerprint of each source against the value stored here; only differences get the expensive extraction. Updated automatically at the end of each successful sync. Committed so history shows what synced when. Keys are added per source as it's registered; starts empty. Each source's slot carries a synced flag: /add-source writes it as false, and the source's first successful sync sets it to true alongside lastFullSync, so the session-start tripwire can tell one never-synced source apart in a brain whose other sources have synced. FORMATTING IS A CONTRACT: multi-line, one key per line, 2-space indent — the dependency-free session-start tripwire in .claude/settings.json parses this with grep. Never rewrite it compact.
